rules.text: A product must declare a canonical risk_level (low|moderate|high|clinical).
The applicable Domain Authority Pack must exist and cover the product's risk class.
A scope boundary must be recorded (transformation.safety.scope_boundary).
A required disclosure/disclaimer must be present.
Escalation behaviour must be defined and must never invent a jurisdiction-specific service without approved evidence.
Prohibited behaviours (diagnosis, prescribing, regulated-advice drift, therapy, guarantees) must be absent.
Clinical/regulated domains require a clinical Domain Authority Pack; a non-clinical domain must NOT be forced into clinical review.
Red-flag criteria, where the pack/risk class requires them, must come from authoritative literature, not be invented.
Misleading certainty, harmful omissions and dangerous sequencing must be absent (semantic judgment where required).
Rescue/failure behaviour must route back into the mechanism and never substitute motivational prose for a rescue.

automatic_authorization_conditions: an ACTIVE, applicable Domain Authority Pack covers the risk class
automatic_rejection_conditions: required Domain Authority Pack missing or not covering the risk class
escalation undefined or invents an unapproved service

provenance.note: Encodes the existing safety standard. CORRECTS the legacy semantics by which any elevated risk implied CLINICAL_AUTHORITY (a human clinician); clinical authority is now required only when the DOMAIN is genuinely clinical.
